root_cause: A personal LinkedIn post on 2026-10-10 contained literal ** emphasis and --- separators, an unsourced 'zeven op de tien mkb-bedrijven' statistic, internal operational delivery status and too many words. The generator only required first person + a build keyword and set final_copy_approved=false. The identity review checked truth anchors but not canonical Notion editorial contract, and the publisher did not enforce editorial approval before consuming publication authority.
prevention: Use the existing Notion personal founder journey and voice rules as a hard 130–200 word, plain-text, first-person authentic story with an open conversational question, not a technical report or corporate pitch.

Reject Markdown delimiters, inline promotional links, emoji, system/protocol status dumps, unverified numerical public claims, and unverifiable delivery-status bragging before computing final text hash.
Require exact independent public-source verification for every numeric public claim, and never treat source_backed:true as proof of an unrelated statistic.

Apply one shared pure editorial validator inside the canonical Anthropic/Composio generator, independent pre-publish reviewer, and existing social publisher before daily capability issuance, global uniqueness reservation, or external provider mutation.
Persist final_copy_approved=true and editorial policy version only when the checked final text passes, while preserving all existing identity, OAuth, provider receipt and single-writer safeguards.
Never duplicate the already published 2026-10-10 personal post; correction must be an in-place edit only when actually authorized and provider-supported.
production_claim: Only protected CI, merged branch, exact production Edge parity, and authenticated review API replay may show prevention live. This does not constitute correction of already published external LinkedIn post.
